title: From cluster checks to a CNCF submission

scenes.heading: Preparing a CNCF submission?
scenes.sub: Anchor it to the Kubernetes minor
voice: Your team wants to submit an AI platform for CNCF conformance.
Start with the specific cluster and Kubernetes version, then match the required checklist for that submission.

scenes.heading: Exercise the required capabilities
scenes.sub: Run conformance against the live cluster
voice: Select a recipe with the required proof paths and run conformance validation.
Examples include checks for accelerator access, gang scheduling, and metrics on the running cluster.

scenes.heading: Collect proof for reviewers
voice: Enable submission output so AICR writes the files reviewers need.
The package maps the check results and supporting evidence to the selected version of the upstream requirements.

scenes.heading: Review gaps before submitting
scenes.sub: Keep the check results with the package
voice: Read the requirement outcomes and investigate any gaps.
Submit the resulting package so reviewers can see exactly which capabilities your platform demonstrated on this Kubernetes version.

payoff: Run version-matched conformance checks and review the generated package for a specific cluster submission.
